entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Okay, I can certainly help with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's a jersey. It's the wrong size.
I see. So it's not a technical fault, just a preference on the fit? Is it too big, or perhaps too tight?
Understood. That can definitely happen. Do you have the order number handy so I can look that up for you?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Mesh Jersey, delivered on October 5th. That was about 85 days ago. Let me just confirm our return policy here.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and you are well within the 90-day window for returns. We can definitely get this processed. Would you like to do an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer a full refund?
A refund. I've already bought something else while I was on hold.

Not a problem at all. I have processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Also, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble with the sizing, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Fine. I guess that's something. Just make sure the label actually arrives.
It will be there shortly. Once we receive the jersey back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
